rv.q: Go with a few pals, pregame it and keep your expectations reasonable.
All told, BACHELOR: THE UNAUTHORIZED PARODY MUSICAL is exceedingly clever, legitimately funny, and far wittier than the ABC series itself.

With a television show that was just begging to be parodied, featuring over-the-top characters and witty songs, this is an hilariously entertaining way to both warm your heart on a cold, winter Chicago evening, while offering so many laughs in the process.

From simple, effective jokes like naming every contestant Lauren, to more biting jabs about the show’s morally questionable and often manufactured “trauma bonding,” the musical appeals thanks to its pace, spot-on mockery, and the cast’s infectious enthusiasm.
Time to step away from your TV, get out to the theater and watch one of your favorite TV shows from a different perspective- have some fun.

cn.t: This 75-minute parody effectively skewers The Bachelor's tired tropes with fresh performances and sharp satirical songs, drawing sizable audiences despite its potentially cringe-inducing premise.
